question: What is total assets at year-end (from the audited balance sheet)?
rationale: Two complementary rules suffice. rule_consolidated_balance_sheet_total_assets retrieves the audited Consolidated Balance Sheet table (matched via 'Total assets' + 'Consolidated Balance Sheet' in path_text or text body) along with same-page section headers and '(in millions)' notes so the QA model emits proper units. Singleton coverage is 0.9; it misses CORNING_2022_10K because that filing's parsed table has only one labelled year column. rule_cover_fiscal_year_end pulls the cover-page 'For the fiscal year ended <date>' span (page <= 3), giving the QA an unambiguous anchor for which year is year-end. Combined, the two rules achieve match_rate 1.0 on all 10 sampled docs at sum_avg_cost_ratio 0.0077.
